comments.body:
4-item Album consisting of items plundered from the Labyrinth endless dungeon's mythic guardian, the Minotaur. List:

Rotting Bracelet
Ancient Map
King Minos' Amulet
Nectar

Reward: King Minos' Earrings
El Greco (Seville)

Further info can be found on the items' respective pages. Cheers.
